references.text: Parallel law text in Deuteronomy that repeats the same rules about clean water-dwelling creatures with fins and scales that are permitted to be eaten.
Ezekiel's vision mentions fishermen by the water, which presupposes knowledge of which fish were allowed to be eaten according to the Mosaic Law.
Jesus' parable about the dragnet that gathers fish of every kind, where some are kept and others discarded, reflects the distinction between clean and unclean water-dwelling creatures.
Jesus calls fishermen by the Sea of Galilee, who fished for permitted species with fins and scales in fresh water.
